description: Talos and Kubernetes versions in vars.tf are the versions of new clusters; running clusters are upgraded in-cluster (tuppr in the consumer's GitOps repo). Talos supports upgrades only between adjacent minor releases, so a minor bump is never grouped across two minors and never automerges; patches automerge after CI.
Kubernetes follows Talos: a Kubernetes minor needs the Talos minor that supports it, so both minors stay manual.

customManagers.description: Versions pinned in Terraform variables with a # renovate: comment on the line above the default.
Versions pinned in scripts with a # renovate: comment on the line above.

packageRules.description: Talos: patches automerge; one minor at a time, by hand.
Kubernetes: patches automerge; minors by hand, after the Talos minor that supports them.
Providers: automerge after CI (the plan check shows the effect on the live deployment).
